sanskrit_iast: na garbhiṇīṃ dīkṣayed ity eke 'yajñiyā garbhā iti śruteḥ //
meaning: न गर्भिणीं दीक्षयेद् इत्य् एके ऽयज्ञिया गर्भा इति श्रुतेः //
text_mt: One should not consecrate a pregnant woman, say some, because of the scriptural statement: "Embryos are unfit for sacrifice."
Not so, because of the context of the anūbandhyā cow.

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣito 'manojñam̐ svapnaṃ dṛṣṭvā japet paryāvarte duḥṣvapnyāt \ pāpaḥ svapnād abhūtyai \ brahmāham antaraṃ karave \ paraḥ svapna mukhā kṛdhi \\ iti //
meaning: दीक्षितो ऽमनोज्ञम्̐ स्वप्नं दृष्ट्वा जपेत् पर्यावर्ते दुःष्वप्न्यात् \ पापः स्वप्नाद् अभूत्यै \ ब्रह्माहम् अन्तरं करवे \ परः स्वप्न मुखा कृधि \\ इति //
text_mt: If the consecrated one sees an unpleasant dream, he should murmur: "I turn away from bad dreaming, away from evil dreaming unto misfortune; I make the sacred formula my protection; place the dream far away, O mouth!"

sanskrit_iast: indriyam̐ skannam adbhir upasiñcet \\ yo me 'dya payaso rasaḥ \ pari doṣād udarpithaḥ \ agnihotram iva somena \ tam ahaṃ punar ādade \\ iti //
meaning: इन्द्रियम्̐ स्कन्नम् अद्भिर् उपसिञ्चेत् \\ यो मे ऽद्य पयसो रसः \ परि दोषाद् उदर्पिथः \ अग्निहोत्रम् इव सोमेन \ तम् अहं पुनर् आददे \\ इति //
text_mt: If semen is spilled, he should sprinkle it with water [saying]: "Whatever essence of milk of mine today has arisen out of night, that do I take back again, like the Agnihotra with soma."

sanskrit_iast: udakaṃ cet taret tad abhimantrayeta \\ undatīr balaṃ dhatta \\ ojo dhatta \ saho dhatta \ mā me dīkṣāṃ mā tapo nirbadhiṣṭa \\ iti //
meaning: उदकं चेत् तरेत् तद् अभिमन्त्रयेत \\ उन्दतीर् बलं धत्त \\ ओजो धत्त \ सहो धत्त \ मा मे दीक्षां मा तपो निर्बधिष्ट \\ इति //
text_mt: If he crosses water, he should address it with: "O moistening ones, bestow strength, bestow vigor, bestow might; do not destroy my consecration, nor my ascetic heat!"

sanskrit_iast: amedhyaṃ dṛṣṭvā sūryam upatiṣṭheta \\ abaddhaṃ mano daridraṃ cakṣuḥ sūryo jyotiṣām̐ śreṣṭho dīkṣe mā mā hāsīt \\ iti //
meaning: अमेध्यं दृष्ट्वा सूर्यम् उपतिष्ठेत \\ अबद्धं मनो दरिद्रं चक्षुः सूर्यो ज्योतिषाम्̐ श्रेष्ठो दीक्षे मा मा हासीत् \\ इति //
text_mt: Having seen an impure thing, he should attend upon the Sun with: "Unbound is the mind, poor is the eye; the Sun is the best of lights; O consecration, do not abandon me!"

sanskrit_iast: śoṇitaṃ cet kuryāt \\ rudriyābhyo 'dbhyaḥ svāhā \\ iti juhuyāt //
meaning: शोणितं चेत् कुर्यात् \\ रुद्रियाभ्यो ऽद्भ्यः स्वाहा \\ इति जुहुयात् //
text_mt: If he should shed blood, he should offer with: "To the waters belonging to Rudra, svāhā!"

meaning: निष्ठीवेच् चेद् बीभत्साभ्यो ऽद्भ्यः स्वाहा \\ इति //
text_mt: If he should spit, with: "To the waters inspiring disgust, svāhā!"
If he should run, with: "To Vāyu, svāhā!"

meaning: स्विद्याच् चेत् तपस्याभ्यो ऽद्भ्यः स्वाहा \\ इति //
text_mt: If he should sweat, with: "To the waters related to heat, svāhā!"
If he should sleep, with: "To Prajāpati, svāhā!"
Upon shedding tears of distress, with: "To the bitter waters, svāhā!"

sanskrit_iast: chardyāviṣṭaḥ payaḥ pītvodakaṃ vā chardayīta niṣṭhyūtavaddhomaḥ //
meaning: छर्द्याविष्टः पयः पीत्वोदकं वा छर्दयीत निष्ठ्यूतवद्धोमः //
text_mt: One seized by vomiting, having drunk milk or water, should vomit; the oblation is like that for spitting.

sanskrit_iast: vayasāvaprasrute camase 'ntarikṣeṇa patati yātudhānaprabodhitaś camasam \\ yam abhyacuścutad agniṣ ṭachundhatād iha punaḥ svāhā \\ iti //
meaning: वयसावप्रस्रुते चमसे ऽन्तरिक्षेण पतति यातुधानप्रबोधितश् चमसम् \\ यम् अभ्यचुश्चुतद् अग्निष् टछुन्धताद् इह पुनः स्वाहा \\ इति //
text_mt: When [the soma] in a cup has been flown over by a bird, [the oblation is offered] with: "Flown through the atmosphere, roused by evil spirits, which cup it has dripped upon—may Agni purify that here again, svāhā!"

sanskrit_iast: abhyupākṛtacamasam upasthe kṛtvā \\ agna āyāhi vītaye \ gṛṇāno havyadātaye \ ni hotā satsi barhiṣi svāhā \\ iti //
meaning: अभ्युपाकृतचमसम् उपस्थे कृत्वा \\ अग्न आयाहि वीतये \ गृणानो हव्यदातये \ नि होता सत्सि बर्हिषि स्वाहा \\ इति //
text_mt: Having placed on his lap the cup that has been flown over, [he offers] with: "Come, O Agni, to the feast, praised for the giving of oblations; sit down as Hotṛ priest on the sacrificial grass, svāhā!"
Or at the Āgnīdhra fire with the verse beginning: "The golden embryo..."
Upon the commingling of offered and unoffered [soma], having turned a burning coal inside the enclosing sticks,

sanskrit_iast: kuśataruṇena juhoti hutasya cāhutasya ca \\ ahutasya hutasya ca \ pītāpītasya somasya \\ indrāgnī pibatam̐ sutam iti //
meaning: कुशतरुणेन जुहोति हुतस्य चाहुतस्य च \\ अहुतस्य हुतस्य च \ पीतापीतस्य सोमस्य \\ इन्द्राग्नी पिबतम्̐ सुतम् इति //
text_mt: he offers with a shoot of kuśa grass, [reciting]: "Of the offered and of the unoffered, of the unoffered and of the offered, of the soma drunk and undrunk, do ye drink the pressed [soma], O Indra and Agni!"
[Or] with: "Svāhā to Cuknī!" at the secondary vaṣaṭ-call.
Or [he offers] at the time of the mixture, because of the capacity to befall [then].

sanskrit_iast: tasya bhakṣaṇam mā yajamānaṃ tamo vidan martvijas \\ mā yaḥ somam imaṃ pibā \ sam̐sṛṣṭam abhayaṃ kratum iti //
meaning: तस्य भक्षणम् मा यजमानं तमो विदन् मर्त्विजस् \\ मा यः सोमम् इमं पिबा \ सम्̐सृष्टम् अभयं क्रतुम् इति //
text_mt: The consumption of it [takes place] with: "May darkness not find the sacrificer, nor the officiating priests, nor him who drinks this soma; [may] the united sacrifice [be] free from danger."

sanskrit_iast: avavṛṣṭabhakṣaṇam indur indum avāgāt \ tasya ta indav indrapītasyendriyāvato gāyatrachandasaḥ sarvagaṇasya sarvagaṇa upahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi \\ iti //
meaning: अववृष्टभक्षणम् इन्दुर् इन्दुम् अवागात् \ तस्य त इन्दव् इन्द्रपीतस्येन्द्रियावतो गायत्रछन्दसः सर्वगणस्य सर्वगण उपहूतस्योपहूतो भक्षयामि \\ इति //
text_mt: The consumption of [soma] rained upon [is performed] with: "Drop has gone to drop; of that of yours, O drop, drunk by Indra, possessing strength, possessing the Gāyatrī metre, possessing the whole company—[I,] possessing the whole company, invited, eat [of you,] invited."
With "possessing the Triṣṭubh metre", "possessing the Jagatī metre", according to the soma pressing.

sanskrit_iast: patitaṃ camasam ālabhate \\ askan parjanyaḥ pṛthivīm \ askan gām ṛṣabho yuvā \ askannemā viśvā bhūtāni \ pra skannāj jāyatām̐ havir iti //
meaning: पतितं चमसम् आलभते \\ अस्कन् पर्जन्यः पृथिवीम् \ अस्कन् गाम् ऋषभो युवा \ अस्कन्नेमा विश्वा भूतानि \ प्र स्कन्नाज् जायताम्̐ हविर् इति //
text_mt: He touches a fallen cup with: "Parjanya has leaped upon the earth; the young bull has leaped upon the cow; they have leaped upon all these beings; may the oblation arise from what has spilled!"

sanskrit_iast: uttarapūrve juhoty uparave camasaṃ duṣṭam \\ prajāpataye svāhā \\ ity atha ye 'nye 'nādiṣṭās tān khare juhuyāt \\ agnaye vaiśvānarāya svāhā \\ iti nārāśam̐saś ced upavāyāt tad uktam //
meaning: उत्तरपूर्वे जुहोत्य् उपरवे चमसं दुष्टम् \\ प्रजापतये स्वाहा \\ इत्य् अथ ये ऽन्ये ऽनादिष्टास् तान् खरे जुहुयात् \\ अग्नये वैश्वानराय स्वाहा \\ इति नाराशम्̐सश् चेद् उपवायात् तद् उक्तम् //
text_mt: He offers the spoiled cup in the north-eastern sounding hole with: "To Prajāpati svāhā!" Then those which are other [and] unspecified he should offer on the mound with: "To Agni Vaiśvānara svāhā!" If the Nārāśaṃsa [cup] should dry up, that has [already] been stated.

sanskrit_iast: antyād vā grahāt stokam āsicya bhakṣayeyuḥ //
meaning: अन्त्याद् वा ग्रहात् स्तोकम् आसिच्य भक्षयेयुः //
text_mt: Or, having poured a drop from the last soma cup, they should consume it.
If a jar should dry up, some [prescribe] the pouring in of milk.
If the pressing-stone breaks, they should chant with the Māruta-Brahmasāman.
And there is the offering of thirty-four [oblations].
In the case of soma theft, he should say: "Run in all directions! Search!"
If it is not found, he should press red-flowered Arjuna [plants].

sanskrit_iast: śyenahṛtaṃ pūtīkān ādārān aruṇadūrvā haritakuśān pūrvālābhepūrvālābha uttarān //
meaning: श्येनहृतं पूतीकान् आदारान् अरुणदूर्वा हरितकुशान् पूर्वालाभेपूर्वालाभ उत्तरान् //
text_mt: [Or] hawk-carried [plants], Pūtīkas, Ādāras, red Dūrvā grass, green Kuśa grass—the subsequent ones on the unavailability of each preceding one.

sanskrit_iast: ekāṃ gāṃ dattvā samāpya punar yajñaḥ //
meaning: एकां गां दत्त्वा समाप्य पुनर् यज्ञः //
text_mt: Having given one cow and completed [the rite], the sacrifice is performed again.
Or [performed again] at the end of the purificatory bath, because of the authority of the scripture.
If a jar breaks, the Brahmasāman has the vaṣaṭ-call as its cadence.
He gives the call: "Procure [what remains]!"

sanskrit_iast: yad anulabheraṃs tad ekadhanair abhyunnīya prabhāvayantaḥ pracareyuḥ //
meaning: यद् अनुलभेरंस् तद् एकधनैर् अभ्युन्नीय प्रभावयन्तः प्रचरेयुः //
text_mt: Whatever they procure, drawing it up with the Ekadhana waters and multiplying it, they should proceed.
Or if none is obtained, [they proceed] from the Āgrayaṇa [vessel] as before.

sanskrit_iast: anītāsu ced dakṣiṇāsu bhedanaṃ pūrvavad dattvā tathaiva yajñaḥ //
meaning: अनीतासु चेद् दक्षिणासु भेदनं पूर्ववद् दत्त्वा तथैव यज्ञः //
text_mt: If the breakage occurs when the sacrificial gifts have not [yet] been brought, having given [a gift] as before, the sacrifice is just the same.

sanskrit_iast: prātaḥsavanāc cet somo 'tiricyeta tam unnīyopākaraṇam asti somo ayam iti //
meaning: प्रातःसवनाच् चेत् सोमो ऽतिरिच्येत तम् उन्नीयोपाकरणम् अस्ति सोमो अयम् इति //
text_mt: If soma should be left over from the morning pressing, having drawn it up, the preliminary rite [is performed with]: "This soma exists."
They should chant with the Gāyatra [melody] on the [verses] addressed to the Maruts.
The Hotṛ priest recites [a hymn] addressed to Indra and Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast: yasmāt stomād atiricyeta sa eva kāryaḥ sarvatra //
meaning: यस्मात् स्तोमाद् अतिरिच्येत स एव कार्यः सर्वत्र //
text_mt: From whichever chant-form it should be left over, that very one is to be made in every case.
If [left over] from the midday pressing, the preliminary rite is as before.

sanskrit_iast: baṇ mahā3m̐ asi \\ iti bṛhatīṣv ādityavatīṣu gaurīvitena stuvīran //
meaning: बण् महा3म्̐ असि \\ इति बृहतीष्व् आदित्यवतीषु गौरीवितेन स्तुवीरन् //
text_mt: They should chant with the Gaurīvita [melody] on Bṛhatī verses addressed to the Ādityas, beginning with: "Truly great art thou!"
If [left over] from the third pressing, [they chant] with the Gaurīvita [melody] on [verses] addressed to Viṣṇu Śipiviṣṭa.
Having done this, or having drawn the Ukthya [cup], he should divide [the cups].
If [left over] from the Ukthya, the Ṣoḍaśin is to be performed.
If from the Ṣoḍaśin, the Atirātra.
Some [say] the Mahāvrata, as stated.

meaning: अन्त्याच् चेत् तस्यैवावृत्तिर् नातीरेको ऽस्तीति श्रुतेः //
text_mt: If from the last, repetition of that very one, because of the scriptural statement: "There is no leftover."
Some [say that] the leftover from a previous pressing is to be purified in the subsequent [pressing].
Because of the scriptural statement: "Desiring it, he was left over."
If [left over] from the third pressing, having poured it into the Hāriyojana [vessel], the offering [is made].
If forgotten, it is taken down into the water mixed with the dregs.

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣitaś ced upatapyetopyānāṃ yenechet tena cikitset //
meaning: दीक्षितश् चेद् उपतप्येतोप्यानां येनेछेत् तेन चिकित्सेत् //
text_mt: If the consecrated [sacrificer] should fall ill, he should treat him with whichever of the means he may wish.

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhram enaṃ nayata \\ iti brūyāt kṛtaṃ cet //
meaning: आग्नीध्रम् एनं नयत \\ इति ब्रूयात् कृतं चेत् //
text_mt: If it has been built, he should say: "Carry him to the Āgnīdhra [shed]!"

sanskrit_iast: vāsatīvaram udakam ācāmed ity eke cātvālagatābhyaḥ //
meaning: वासतीवरम् उदकम् आचामेद् इत्य् एके चात्वालगताभ्यः //
text_mt: Some [say] he should sip Vāsatīvarī water from [that] brought to the Cātvāla pit,

sanskrit_iast: āpaḥ prajāpatir yajño yajñasya bheṣajam asi \\ iti //
meaning: आपः प्रजापतिर् यज्ञो यज्ञस्य भेषजम् असि \\ इति //
text_mt: with: "Water is Prajāpati, the sacrifice; you are the medicine of the sacrifice."

sanskrit_iast: anusavanam enam ālabheran vasava etad vaḥ prātaḥsavanam \\ tad rakṣadhvam \\ tad gopāyadhvam \\ tad vo mā vyavachaitsīt \\ iti //
meaning: अनुसवनम् एनम् आलभेरन् वसव एतद् वः प्रातःसवनम् \\ तद् रक्षध्वम् \\ तद् गोपायध्वम् \\ तद् वो मा व्यवछैत्सीत् \\ इति //
text_mt: At each soma pressing they should touch him with: "O Vasus, this is your morning pressing; protect it, guard it, let it not cut you off!"
"O Rudras", "O Ādityas", at the subsequent two soma pressings.

sanskrit_iast: mriyeta cen nirmanthyena dagdhvā śāmitrād vāsthīny upanahya nediṣṭhinam upadīkṣya tena saha yajeran //
meaning: म्रियेत चेन् निर्मन्थ्येन दग्ध्वा शामित्राद् वास्थीन्य् उपनह्य नेदिष्ठिनम् उपदीक्ष्य तेन सह यजेरन् //
text_mt: If he should die, having cremated [him] with churned fire or [fire] from the slaughtering place, [and] having tied up the bones, having consecrated the nearest [relative], they should sacrifice with him.
In a sacrificial session or group sacrifice, because of the word denoting together-ness.
In a single[-sacrificer] sacrifice, it is like the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: etat kṛtvā rājānam abhiṣutyāgṛhītvā grahān dakṣiṇapūrvasyāṃ vedisraktyāṃ yāmena stuvīran //
meaning: एतत् कृत्वा राजानम् अभिषुत्यागृहीत्वा ग्रहान् दक्षिणपूर्वस्यां वेदिस्रक्त्यां यामेन स्तुवीरन् //
text_mt: Having done this, having pressed soma and not having drawn the soma cups, they should chant with the Yāma [melody] at the south-eastern corner of the altar,
on three consecutive verses of the Queen of Serpents.

sanskrit_iast: stute mārjālīyaṃ triḥ pariyanty apasavyam̐ savyorūn āghnānā stotriyā japantaḥ //
meaning: स्तुते मार्जालीयं त्रिः परियन्त्य् अपसव्यम्̐ सव्योरून् आघ्नाना स्तोत्रिया जपन्तः //
text_mt: When it has been chanted, they go round the Mārjālīya [hearth] three times towards the left, striking their left thighs and murmuring the chant-verse.

sanskrit_iast: agna āyūm̐ṣi pavase \\ iti pratipad bhavati //
meaning: अग्न आयूम्̐षि पवसे \\ इति प्रतिपद् भवति //
text_mt: "O Agni, thou purifiest lifetimes" is the opening verse.
At the end of a year, they should cause the bones to sacrifice.
Because of the completion of the ritual, since death [after the event] cannot [affect it].
They should sacrifice with an unmeasured chant.
Or with the Bahiṣpavamāna chanting in nine verses.
He should draw the cups beginning with the Maitrāvaruṇa cup.
A substitute should perform the duties of the sacrificer,
Except for the consecration offering, personal consecration rites, and prayers for blessings.
When it is finished, they should scatter the bones together with the vessels in the wilderness.
Or there is a re-burning, because the vessels are employed [with the body].

sanskrit_iast: ukhāṃ ced bibhran mriyeta sopakaraṇam āhitāgnyāvṛtā dagdhvā nediṣṭhyagniṃ citvā tam asmā anudiśed ity eke //
meaning: उखां चेद् बिभ्रन् म्रियेत सोपकरणम् आहिताग्न्यावृता दग्ध्वा नेदिष्ठ्यग्निं चित्वा तम् अस्मा अनुदिशेद् इत्य् एके //
text_mt: Some say: If he should die while bearing the fire-pan, having burned [him] along with the equipment according to the procedure for an Āhitāgni, having piled the fire nearest to him, he should assign it to him.
Not so, because of the impossibility of [attaining] the fruit of the rite.

sanskrit_iast: upadīkṣī sveṣv agniṣu nakhanikṛntanādy udvādanāntam̐ sāṃnipātikam //
meaning: उपदीक्षी स्वेष्व् अग्निषु नखनिकृन्तनाद्य् उद्वादनान्तम्̐ सांनिपातिकम् //
text_mt: The secondary initiate [performs] upon his own fires the concurrent rites beginning with the paring of nails and ending with the raising of the voice.
Having offered the permission-rite on them, he should combine the fires.

sanskrit_iast: anāhitāgniś cet teṣv evety eke vaiśvānaraṃ nirvaped yasyāgnibhir anyaṃ yājayeyur iti vacanāt //
meaning: अनाहिताग्निश् चेत् तेष्व् एवेत्य् एके वैश्वानरं निर्वपेद् यस्याग्निभिर् अन्यं याजयेयुर् इति वचनात् //
text_mt: Some say: If he has not set up sacred fires, [it is done] on those very ones, because of the statement, "He should offer to Vaiśvānara whose fires they sacrifice for another with."

sanskrit_iast: samānajanapadasam̐save mahārātre prātaranuvākam upākṛtya pūrvaḥpūrvaḥ karma pravartayet //
meaning: समानजनपदसम्̐सवे महारात्रे प्रातरनुवाकम् उपाकृत्य पूर्वःपूर्वः कर्म प्रवर्तयेत् //
text_mt: In a simultaneous pressing in the same region, having begun the morning recitation in the dead of night, whoever is earlier should proceed with the rite.
And he should make the completion of the rite earlier.
If he desires [victory], the opening verse contains the word "bull".
The Pṛṣṭha stotras are the Bṛhat and the Rathantara.
Because scripture mentions its insertion into the Tauraśravasa chant at the midday Pavamāna.
Some [prescribe] the Ābhīka chant, having an inserted refrain, and the Ābhīśava chants.

sanskrit_iast: prātaḥsavane juhoti saṃveśāyopaveśāya gāyatryai chandase 'bhibhūtyai svāhā \\ iti //
meaning: प्रातःसवने जुहोति संवेशायोपवेशाय गायत्र्यै छन्दसे ऽभिभूत्यै स्वाहा \\ इति //
text_mt: At the morning pressing, he offers: "To lying down, to sitting down, to the Gāyatrī metre, to over-powering, svāhā!"
"To the Triṣṭubh", "To the Jagatī", in the subsequent two soma pressings.
The Hotṛ priest recites the Vihavīya, the Sajanīya, and the Kayāśubhīya hymns.
Desiring death together with friends, they should offer with the verse addressed to Prajāpati.
At the morning pressing, the Adhvaryu; at the midday pressing, the Hotṛ; the Udgātṛ at the third pressing.
At each soma pressing, the Brahman priest and the master of the house.
Desiring the death of all, everyone [offers] at each soma pressing.
It is not a simultaneous pressing across a river, if divided by a mountain;
Everywhere for those who bear no mutual hatred.

sanskrit_iast: vidveṣe 'py ayaṃ vāyur mahānt samudra iti śruteḥ //
meaning: विद्वेषे ऽप्य् अयं वायुर् महान्त् समुद्र इति श्रुतेः //
text_mt: Even when there is hatred, because of the Vedic text: "This wind is a great ocean."
In case the soma burns, they should keep their places as appropriate.
Having substituted [it], they should proceed with the sacrifice as before.

sanskrit_iast: pañca gā dattvā prāg dvādaśyāḥ punar yajñaḥ //
meaning: पञ्च गा दत्त्वा प्राग् द्वादश्याः पुनर् यज्ञः //
text_mt: Having given five cows before the twelfth day, there is a repeat sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: tatra tad dadyād yat pūrvasmin dāsyant syāt sattre 'py aviśeṣāt //
meaning: तत्र तद् दद्याद् यत् पूर्वस्मिन् दास्यन्त् स्यात् सत्त्रे ऽप्य् अविशेषात् //
text_mt: There he should give what he would have given in the former, even in a sacrificial session, because there is no distinction.
A giving [is done] because of the connection with expiation.
However, there is bringing back [of the soma] on that day.
The Brahman priest should offer the unprescribed expiations,
Because of the Vedic text: "The Brahman priest repairs what is damaged,"
During the consecrations, he gathers the Mahāvīra pots [materials].

sanskrit_iast: antaḥpātyadeśe sambhārān nidadhāti mṛdaṃ valmīkavapāṃ varāhavihataṃ pūtīkān ajāpayo gavedhukāḥ kṛṣṇājinam abhriṃ cottarataḥ //
meaning: अन्तःपात्यदेशे सम्भारान् निदधाति मृदं वल्मीकवपां वराहविहतं पूतीकान् अजापयो गवेधुकाः कृष्णाजिनम् अभ्रिं चोत्तरतः //
text_mt: He deposits the materials in the Antaḥpātya place: clay, an anthill mound, earth dug up by a boar, pūtīka plants, goat milk, gavedhukā grass, a black-antelope skin, and a spade to the north.

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā \\ ity abhrim ādāyaudumbarīṃ vaikaṅkatīṃ vāratnimātrīm̐ savye kṛtvā dakṣiṇenālabhya japati yuñjate \\ iti //
meaning: देवस्य त्वा \\ इत्य् अभ्रिम् आदायौदुम्बरीं वैकङ्कतीं वारत्निमात्रीम्̐ सव्ये कृत्वा दक्षिणेनालभ्य जपति युञ्जते \\ इति //
text_mt: Taking the spade of udumbara or of vikankata wood, a cubit long, with "At the god's [impulsion]...", putting it in his left hand and touching it with his right, he mutters: "They harness...".

sanskrit_iast: mṛdam ādatte piṇḍavat \\ devī dyāvāpṛthivī iti //
meaning: मृदम् आदत्ते पिण्डवत् \\ देवी द्यावापृथिवी इति //
text_mt: He takes the clay like a lump with "O divine Heaven and Earth..."
He places it on the black-antelope skin toward the north.
The anthill mound with "O divine ants...".
The earth dug up by a boar with "So large in the beginning...".
The pūtīka plants with "Ye are Indra's strength...".
He touches the collected materials with "For Makha...".

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇājinaṃ parigṛhyottarataḥ parivṛtaṃ gachanti praitu brahmaṇaspatir iti //
meaning: कृष्णाजिनं परिगृह्योत्तरतः परिवृतं गछन्ति प्रैतु ब्रह्मणस्पतिर् इति //
text_mt: Holding the black-antelope skin, they go to the enclosed space to the north with "May Brahmaṇaspati advance...".
He deposits the materials inside the enclosure.
[The materials are deposited] in the enclosed space with an east-facing door, which has been dug up, sprinkled with water, and strewn with sand, with [the mantra]: "For Makha..."
He mixes [the clay] with the ingredients with [the mantra]: "For Makha..."

sanskrit_iast: mṛdam ādāya makhāya \\ iti mahāvīraṃ karoti prādeśamātram ūrdhvam āsecanavantaṃ mekhalāvantaṃ madhyasaṃgṛhītam ūrdhvaṃ mekhalāyās tryaṅgulam //
meaning: मृदम् आदाय मखाय \\ इति महावीरं करोति प्रादेशमात्रम् ऊर्ध्वम् आसेचनवन्तं मेखलावन्तं मध्यसंगृहीतम् ऊर्ध्वं मेखलायास् त्र्यङ्गुलम् //
text_mt: Taking the clay with [the mantra]: "For Makha...", he fashions the Mahāvīra pot, a span in height, provided with a pouring lip, provided with a girdle, constricted in the middle, [and] three finger-breadths [in height] above the girdle.
When it is finished, he touches it with [the mantra]: "The head of Makha..."
In the same manner, [he fashions] the other two [pots], each with its respective mantra.
[He fashions] two milch-pails (pinvana) shaped like the bowl of a sruc ladle, and two round Rauhiṇa-potsherds.
He deposits the reserve clay (upaśayā).
He smooths [them] with Gavedhukā seeds with [the mantra]: "For Makha...", each with its respective mantra.

sanskrit_iast: aśvaśakṛtā dhūpayati \\ aśvasya tvā \\ iti pratimantram //
meaning: अश्वशकृता धूपयति \\ अश्वस्य त्वा \\ इति प्रतिमन्त्रम् //
text_mt: He fumigates [them] with horse dung with [the mantra]: "The horse's...", each with its respective mantra.

sanskrit_iast: ukhāvad agniḥ pradahanaṃ ca makhāya \\ iti pratimantram //
meaning: उखावद् अग्निः प्रदहनं च मखाय \\ इति प्रतिमन्त्रम् //
text_mt: The fire and the baking [are performed] like [those of] the Ukhā pot, with [the mantra]: "For Makha...", each with its respective mantra.
He takes them out when baked with [the mantra]: "To the upright one thee...", each with its respective mantra.
He sprinkles [them] with goat's milk with [the mantra]: "For Makha...", each with its respective mantra.
The making, touching, smoothing, fumigating, baking, taking out, and sprinkling of the milch-pails and the rest are done silently.
When about to perform the Upasad rite, one who is to perform [it] performs the Pravargya rite, if [the sacrifice is] accompanied by the Pravargya rite.
The performance of the Pravargya rite takes place with the door closed.
The Parigharmya halter is made of Udumbara wood.
The rope is threefold, made of Muñja grass.
The webbing of the chair made of Udumbara wood, shoulder-high, is of Bālvaja grass.

sanskrit_iast: pūrveṇa gārhapatyaṃ prācaḥ kuśān āstīrya pātrāsādanaṃ dvandvam //
meaning: पूर्वेण गार्हपत्यं प्राचः कुशान् आस्तीर्य पात्रासादनं द्वन्द्वम् //
text_mt: Having spread kuśa grass pointing eastward to the east of the Gārhapatya fire, [there is] the setting down of the utensils in pairs:

sanskrit_iast: upayamanīṃ mahāvīram parīśāsau pinvane rauhiṇakapāle rauhiṇahavanyau ca srucāvanutkīrṇe sthūṇāmayūkham dhṛṣṭī śatamāne muñjapralavān vikaṅkataśakalān vim̐śatiṃ prādeśamātrān sruvaṃ muñjavedam dhavitrāṇi paridhīṃś ca rajjusaṃdānam āsandīṃ kṛṣṇājinam abhrim̐ sikatāḥ kharārthā arthavac ca //
meaning: उपयमनीं महावीरम् परीशासौ पिन्वने रौहिणकपाले रौहिणहवन्यौ च स्रुचावनुत्कीर्णे स्थूणामयूखम् धृष्टी शतमाने मुञ्जप्रलवान् विकङ्कतशकलान् विम्̐शतिं प्रादेशमात्रान् स्रुवं मुञ्जवेदम् धवित्राणि परिधींश् च रज्जुसंदानम् आसन्दीं कृष्णाजिनम् अभ्रिम्̐ सिकताः खरार्था अर्थवच् च //
text_mt: the supporting shovel (upayamanī), the Mahāvīra pot, the two pairs of tongs, the two milch-pails, the two Rauhiṇa-potsherds, the two Rauhiṇa-offering ladles which are uncarved sruc ladles, the peg-post, the two stirring fire-sticks, the two hundred-māna [pieces of silver and gold], the Muñja-grass tufts, twenty chips of Vikaṅkata wood a span in length, the dipping spoon, the Muñja-grass broom, the fans, the enclosing sticks, the cord-fetters, the chair, the black antelope skin, the spade, sand for the mound, and whatever else is required for the purpose.

sanskrit_iast: prokṣaṇīḥ saṃskṛtyodyamyotthāyāha brahman pracariṣyāmas \\ hotar abhiṣṭuhi \ prastotaḥ sāmāni gāya \\ iti //
meaning: प्रोक्षणीः संस्कृत्योद्यम्योत्थायाह ब्रह्मन् प्रचरिष्यामस् \\ होतर् अभिष्टुहि \ प्रस्तोतः सामानि गाय \\ इति //
text_mt: Having prepared the sprinkling waters, lifted [them] up, and stood up, he says: "O Brahman, we shall proceed; Hotṛ, recite the introductory praise; Prastotṛ, sing the Sāmans!"

sanskrit_iast: brahmānujñātas \\ yamāya tvā \\ iti mahāvīraṃ prokṣati //
meaning: ब्रह्मानुज्ञातस् \\ यमाय त्वा \\ इति महावीरं प्रोक्षति //
text_mt: Permitted by the Brahman, he sprinkles the Mahāvīra pot with [the mantra]: "For Yama thee..."
Or [he sprinkles it] mantra by mantra, because of the division of sentences.
And [he sprinkles] the Parigharmya halter silently.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvayā dvārā sthūṇāmayūkhaṃ nirhṛtya dakṣiṇato nidhanati hotuḥ saṃdarśane //
meaning: पूर्वया द्वारा स्थूणामयूखं निर्हृत्य दक्षिणतो निधनति होतुः संदर्शने //
text_mt: Carrying out the peg-post by the eastern door, he drives it in to the south within the Hotṛ's sight.

sanskrit_iast: gārhapatyāhavanīyā uttareṇa kharau nivapati dakṣiṇato 'nubhitty uchiṣṭakharam //
meaning: गार्हपत्याहवनीया उत्तरेण खरौ निवपति दक्षिणतो ऽनुभित्त्य् उछिष्टखरम् //
text_mt: He heaps up two mounds to the north of the Gārhapatya and Āhavanīya fires, [and] the mound for the remnants to the south along the wall.

sanskrit_iast: pūrveṇāhavanīyam̐ samrāḍāsandīṃ paryāhṛtya dakṣiṇataḥ prācīm āsādayati rājāsandyā uttarataḥ kṛṣṇājinam asyām āstṛṇāti tasminn abhryupaśaye nidadhāti mahāvīrau cāvachādayed vā //
meaning: पूर्वेणाहवनीयम्̐ सम्राडासन्दीं पर्याहृत्य दक्षिणतः प्राचीम् आसादयति राजासन्द्या उत्तरतः कृष्णाजिनम् अस्याम् आस्तृणाति तस्मिन्न् अभ्र्युपशये निदधाति महावीरौ चावछादयेद् वा //
text_mt: Carrying the emperor's chair (samrāḍ-āsandī) around by the east of the Āhavanīya fire, he sets it down to the south facing east, to the north of the king's chair; on it he spreads the black antelope skin; upon it he places the spade and the reserve clay, and the two [other] Mahāvīra pots, or he should cover [them].
Or another [priest performs] the hitching of the Parigharmya halter, so that the Adhvaryu's time is met.

sanskrit_iast: añjanti \\ ity ucyamāne devas tvā \\ ity anakti mahāvīram ājyam̐ saṃskṛtya //
meaning: अञ्जन्ति \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने देवस् त्वा \\ इत्य् अनक्ति महावीरम् आज्यम्̐ संस्कृत्य //
text_mt: While "They anoint..." is being recited, having prepared the clarified butter, he anoints the Mahāvīra pot with [the mantra]: "May the god thee..."

sanskrit_iast: rajataśatamānaṃ khara upagūhati pṛthivyāḥ sam̐spṛśas \\ iti //
meaning: रजतशतमानं खर उपगूहति पृथिव्याः सम्̐स्पृशस् \\ इति //
text_mt: He buries the silver hundred-māna piece in the mound with [the mantra]: "From contact with the earth..."
He prompts: "Sing the Śukra chant!"

sanskrit_iast: sam̐sīdasva \\ ity ucyamāne muñjapralavān dviguṇān ādīpya pratidiśaṃ khare karoti //
meaning: सम्̐सीदस्व \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने मुञ्जप्रलवान् द्विगुणान् आदीप्य प्रतिदिशं खरे करोति //
text_mt: While "Sit down..." is being recited, having ignited the doubled Muñja-grass tufts, he places them in each direction upon the mound.

sanskrit_iast: teṣu mahāvīram ājyavantam arcir asi \\ iti //
meaning: तेषु महावीरम् आज्यवन्तम् अर्चिर् असि \\ इति //
text_mt: Upon them [he sets] the Mahāvīra pot filled with clarified butter with [the mantra]: "Thou art the glow..."

sanskrit_iast: anādhṛṣṭā \\ iti vācayati prādeśam adhyadhi dhārayantam //
meaning: अनाधृष्टा \\ इति वाचयति प्रादेशम् अध्यधि धारयन्तम् //
text_mt: He makes [the sacrificer] recite [the mantra]: "Unassailable...", while holding his span directly above it.

sanskrit_iast: viśvābhyo mā \\ iti dakṣiṇata uttānaṃ pāṇiṃ nidadhāti //
meaning: विश्वाभ्यो मा \\ इति दक्षिणत उत्तानं पाणिं निदधाति //
text_mt: He places his palm turned upward to the south with [the mantra]: "Protect me from all..."
[He places] a span to the north with [the mantra]: "The mares of Manu..."

sanskrit_iast: dhṛṣṭilbhyāṃ bhasmanā parikīryāṅgāraiś ca vikaṅkataśakalaiḥ pariśrayati trayodaśabhiḥ prāgudagbhiḥ svāhā marudbhir iti //
meaning: धृष्टिल्भ्यां भस्मना परिकीर्याङ्गारैश् च विकङ्कतशकलैः परिश्रयति त्रयोदशभिः प्रागुदग्भिः स्वाहा मरुद्भिर् इति //
text_mt: Having scattered ash around [the pot] with the two fire-sticks and [having scattered] burning coals, he encloses it with thirteen Vikaṅkata chips pointing eastward and northward, with [the formula]: "Svāhā to the Maruts!"
[He places] an additional one to the south, [and] two with the mantra.
He covers it with the gold hundred-māna piece with [the mantra]: "From contact with the sky..."
And he prompts: "Sing the Candra chant!"

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇājināvakṛttair dhavitrair upavājayati tribhir daṇḍavadbhir madhu madhu \\ iti //
meaning: कृष्णाजिनावकृत्तैर् धवित्रैर् उपवाजयति त्रिभिर् दण्डवद्भिर् मधु मधु \\ इति //
text_mt: He fans it with three fanning-fans cut from black antelope skin, provided with handles, [whispering]: "Honey! Honey!"

sanskrit_iast: ekaṃ prayachati pratiprasthātre 'param agnīdhe dhūnvantas tristriḥ parikrāmanti pitṛvad devavac ca //
meaning: एकं प्रयछति प्रतिप्रस्थात्रे ऽपरम् अग्नीधे धून्वन्तस् त्रिस्त्रिः परिक्रामन्ति पितृवद् देववच् च //
text_mt: He hands one [fan] to the Pratiprasthātṛ, the other to the Agnīdh; fanning, they walk around three times each in the manner of the Pitṛs and in the manner of the gods.

sanskrit_iast: arciṣi prāpte suvarṇaśatamānaṃ nidhāyājyena mahāvīraṃ pariṣiñcati sruveṇa pratipraṇavam //
meaning: अर्चिषि प्राप्ते सुवर्णशतमानं निधायाज्येन महावीरं परिषिञ्चति स्रुवेण प्रतिप्रणवम् //
text_mt: When the flame has reached [it], having removed the gold hundred-māna piece, he pours clarified butter around the Mahāvīra pot with the dipping spoon at each praṇava syllable.
He places the two Rauhiṇa cakes on the fire silently, [made] of flour from the village.
They have the properties of clarified butter, because of taking its place.
Or they have the properties of vegetable substances, because of the word denoting their preparation.

sanskrit_iast: īḍe dyāvāpṛthivī ity ucyamāne paridhīn paridhāya rauhiṇā udvāsya srucor āsādayaty āhavanīyād dakṣiṇottarau //
meaning: ईडे द्यावापृथिवी इत्य् उच्यमाने परिधीन् परिधाय रौहिणा उद्वास्य स्रुचोर् आसादयत्य् आहवनीयाद् दक्षिणोत्तरौ //
text_mt: While "I praise Heaven and Earth..." is being recited, having laid the enclosing sticks and taken down the two Rauhiṇa cakes, he places them on the two sruc ladles, south and north of the Āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: apnasvatīm ity ucyamāne rucito gharmas \\ ity āhopottiṣṭhan gharmasya tanvau gāya \\ iti preṣyati //
meaning: अप्नस्वतीम् इत्य् उच्यमाने रुचितो घर्मस् \\ इत्य् आहोपोत्तिष्ठन् घर्मस्य तन्वौ गाय \\ इति प्रेष्यति //
text_mt: While "Endowed with wealth..." is being recited, standing up he says: "The Gharma is radiant!", and prompts: "Sing the two bodies of the Gharma!"

meaning: परिक्रम्योपतिष्ठन्ते ऽकृतं चेत् \\ गर्भो देवानाम् इति //
text_mt: Having walked around, they stand waiting; if it is not done [yet], with [the mantra]: "The embryo of the gods..."

sanskrit_iast: tvaṣṭṛmantas \\ ity enāṃ vācayati mahāvīram īkṣamāṇām //
meaning: त्वष्टृमन्तस् \\ इत्य् एनां वाचयति महावीरम् ईक्षमाणाम् //
text_mt: He makes her recite [the mantra]: "Accompanied by Tvaṣṭṛ...", while looking at the Mahāvīra pot.

sanskrit_iast: ahaḥ ketunā \\ iti dakṣiṇam̐ rauhiṇaṃ juhoti mantrakrameṇottaram \\ rātrir iti sāyam //
meaning: अहः केतुना \\ इति दक्षिणम्̐ रौहिणं जुहोति मन्त्रक्रमेणोत्तरम् \\ रात्रिर् इति सायम् //
text_mt: With [the mantra]: "Day with its banner...", he offers the southern Rauhiṇa cake, and the northern one following the order of the mantras; with "Night..." in the evening.

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā \\ iti rajjusaṃdānam ādāya \\ iḍa ehi \\ iti gām āhvayati nāmnā ca trir uccair apareṇa gārhapatyaṃ gachan //
meaning: देवस्य त्वा \\ इति रज्जुसंदानम् आदाय \\ इड एहि \\ इति गाम् आह्वयति नाम्ना च त्रिर् उच्चैर् अपरेण गार्हपत्यं गछन् //
text_mt: Taking the cord-fetters with [the mantra]: "At the impulse of the divine...", he calls the cow with: "Come, O Iḍā!" and by her name three times loudly, going behind the Gārhapatya fire.
He gives the order: "Chant the Dhenu-chant!"

sanskrit_iast: adityai rāsnā \\ iti gāṃ pāśena pratimucya sthūṇāyāṃ baddhvā pūṣāsi \\ iti vatsam utsṛjati //
meaning: अदित्यै रास्ना \\ इति गां पाशेन प्रतिमुच्य स्थूणायां बद्ध्वा पूषासि \\ इति वत्सम् उत्सृजति //
text_mt: Fastening the cow with the cord [saying], "Aditi's girdle [thou art]," and tying [her] to the post, he lets loose the calf [saying], "Thou art Pūṣan."

sanskrit_iast: saṃdāya gharmāya dīṣva \\ iti vatsam unnayati //
meaning: संदाय घर्माय दीष्व \\ इति वत्सम् उन्नयति //
text_mt: Having tied [her legs], he brings the calf near [saying], "Yield milk for the Gharma offering!"
He milks into the milk-pail [saying], "Swell for the two Aśvins!"
He addresses the drops [saying], "Svāhā, accompanied by Indra!"

sanskrit_iast: yas te stanas \\ iti stanam ālabhate //
meaning: यस् ते स्तनस् \\ इति स्तनम् आलभते //
text_mt: He touches a teat [saying], "Which teat of thine..."
In the same manner, the Pratiprasthātṛ [acts with regard to] the she-goat, at a peg, silently.
While "Arise, O Brahmaṇaspati!" is being recited, he stands up.

sanskrit_iast: upadrava payasā \\ ity ucyamāne gachati \\ urv antarikṣam iti //
meaning: उपद्रव पयसा \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने गछति \\ उर्व् अन्तरिक्षम् इति //
text_mt: While "Run near with the milk!" is being recited, he goes [saying], "Wide is the intermediate space..."

sanskrit_iast: parīśāsāv ādatte gāyatraṃ chando 'si \\ iti pratimantram //
meaning: परीशासाव् आदत्ते गायत्रं छन्दो ऽसि \\ इति प्रतिमन्त्रम् //
text_mt: He takes the two pairs of tongs with each respective mantra: "The Gāyatrī metre art thou..."
He gives the order: "Chant the Vasiṣṭhasya śaphau chants!"

sanskrit_iast: tābhyāṃ mahāvīraṃ parigṛhṇāti dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ tvā parigṛhṇāmi \\ iti //
meaning: ताभ्यां महावीरं परिगृह्णाति द्यावापृथिवीभ्यां त्वा परिगृह्णामि \\ इति //
text_mt: With them he seizes the Mahāvīra pot [saying], "With Heaven and Earth I seize thee."
Having lifted [it], wiped [it] with the broom of muñja-grass, he supports [it] from below with the Upayamanī ladle [saying], "With the intermediate space I hold [thee] from below."

sanskrit_iast: ajāpayasāvasicya śānte goḥ payo 'vanayati \\ indrāśvinā \\ iti //
meaning: अजापयसावसिच्य शान्ते गोः पयो ऽवनयति \\ इन्द्राश्विना \\ इति //
text_mt: Having poured goat's milk over [it], when it has quieted down, he pours in the cow's milk [saying], "O Indra and Aśvins!"
While "May Brahmaṇaspati go forth..." is being recited,

sanskrit_iast: samudrāya tvā \\ iti vātanāmāni japati gachann āhavanīyam //
meaning: समुद्राय त्वा \\ इति वातनामानि जपति गछन्न् आहवनीयम् //
text_mt: He mutters the names of the wind [saying], "To the ocean thee..." while going to the Āhavanīya fire.
With the Upayamanī ladle he pours [it] out [saying], "Svāhā to the Gharma offering!"

sanskrit_iast: svāhā gharmaḥ pitre \\ iti japitvātikramyāśrāvyāha gharmasya yaja \\ iti //
meaning: स्वाहा घर्मः पित्रे \\ इति जपित्वातिक्रम्याश्राव्याह घर्मस्य यज \\ इति //
text_mt: Having muttered "Svāhā, the Gharma offering to the Father!", stepped beyond [the fire], and made the call, he says: "Recite the offering-verse for the Gharma offering!"
When the Vaṣaṭ call has been made, he makes the oblation [saying], "All regions..."
He shakes [the pot] upwards three times [saying], "Bestow [it] in heaven!"
When the secondary Vaṣaṭ call is made, [saying,] "Svāhā to Agni!"
The Brahman follows with a recitation: "O Aśvins, the Gharma offering..."
He addresses [the pot] while it swells [saying], "Swell for food!"
He steps out towards the north-eastern direction [saying], "Thou art the law."
He places [it] upon the mound [saying], "Harmless to us!"

sanskrit_iast: vikaṅkataśakalair juhoti gharme nyajyanyajya svāhā pūṣṇe śarase \\ iti pratimantram //
meaning: विकङ्कतशकलैर् जुहोति घर्मे न्यज्यन्यज्य स्वाहा पूष्णे शरसे \\ इति प्रतिमन्त्रम् //
text_mt: With chips of vikaṅkata wood, dipping [each] repeatedly into the Gharma offering, he makes oblations, with each respective mantra: "Svāhā to Pūṣan the strong!"
After making each offering, he leans [the chip] against the first enclosing stick.

sanskrit_iast: caturtham ahutam udaṅṅ īkṣamāṇo dakṣiṇato barhiṣy upagūhati //
meaning: चतुर्थम् अहुतम् उदङ्ङ् ईक्षमाणो दक्षिणतो बर्हिष्य् उपगूहति //
text_mt: The fourth, without offering, while looking northward, he hides southwards in the sacrificial grass.

sanskrit_iast: saptamaṃ ca sarvalepāktaṃ dakṣiṇekṣamāṇaḥ pratiprasthātre prayachati //
meaning: सप्तमं च सर्वलेपाक्तं दक्षिणेक्षमाणः प्रतिप्रस्थात्रे प्रयछति //
text_mt: And the seventh, smeared with all the remnants, he gives to the Pratiprasthātṛ while looking southward.

sanskrit_iast: tam̐ sa uttarataḥ śālāyā udañcaṃ nirasyati //
meaning: तम्̐ स उत्तरतः शालाया उदञ्चं निरस्यति //
text_mt: The latter throws it away north of the hall towards the north.

sanskrit_iast: svāhā saṃ jyotiṣā \\ ity upayamanyām āsiñcati gharmyam //
meaning: स्वाहा सं ज्योतिषा \\ इत्य् उपयमन्याम् आसिञ्चति घर्म्यम् //
text_mt: He pours out what is in the pot into the Upayamanī ladle [saying], "Svāhā, united with light!"
And he throws the [chips] that were leaned [into the fire].

sanskrit_iast: agnihotrāvṛtā hutvā vājinavad bhakṣayanti madhu hutam iti //
meaning: अग्निहोत्रावृता हुत्वा वाजिनवद् भक्षयन्ति मधु हुतम् इति //
text_mt: Having offered in the manner of the Agnihotra, they consume [the remnant] like the Vājina liquid [saying], "The sweet drink is offered..."

sanskrit_iast: ucchiṣṭakhare prakṣālyopayamanīṃ nidadhāty atra vopaśritapraharaṇam̐ sam̐sādyamānāyānuvācayati //
meaning: उच्छिष्टखरे प्रक्षाल्योपयमनीं निदधात्य् अत्र वोपश्रितप्रहरणम्̐ सम्̐साद्यमानायानुवाचयति //
text_mt: Having rinsed the Upayamanī ladle on the refuse-mound, he deposits it; or at this moment occurs the throwing in of the leaned [chips]; he causes [the Hotṛ] to recite for the [pots] being placed down.
Some [say the order should be]: "To the ones being placed down..."

sanskrit_iast: sūyavasād bhagavati \\ ity ucyamāne yavasodake dhenave prayachanty eke //
meaning: सूयवसाद् भगवति \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने यवसोदके धेनवे प्रयछन्त्य् एके //
text_mt: While "O bountiful one, from the good pasture..." is being recited, some give grass and water to the cow.
He places everything on the chair.
The placing and sprinkling are performed only once for the mounds, posts, pegs, black antelope skin, hoe, Upāśaya pot, and chairs.
Or there is repetition, because they belong to the time of the primary rites.
The disposal of the Pravargya apparatus takes place at the end of the Upasad rites.
Having placed the Parigharmya implements on the Antaḥpātya peg, and having carried the refuse-mound out by the south,

sanskrit_iast: āhavanīye trīñ chālākān pradīpyapradīpyāgnīdhro dhārayati śatarudriyavat pratilomaṃ pramāṇeṣu śatarudriyavat pratilomaṃ pramāṇeṣu //
meaning: आहवनीये त्रीञ् छालाकान् प्रदीप्यप्रदीप्याग्नीध्रो धारयति शतरुद्रियवत् प्रतिलोमं प्रमाणेषु शतरुद्रियवत् प्रतिलोमं प्रमाणेषु //
text_mt: Having kindled three firebrands one by one in the Āhavanīya fire, the Agnīdh holds [them], in the manner of the Śatarudriya, in reverse order at the [standard] measures; in the manner of the Śatarudriya, in reverse order at the [standard] measures.

sanskrit_iast: caturgṛhītenābhijuhoti yā te gharma divyā śug iti pratimantram //
meaning: चतुर्गृहीतेनाभिजुहोति या ते घर्म दिव्या शुग् इति प्रतिमन्त्रम् //
text_mt: He makes an oblation with four ladlings [of butter] with each respective mantra: "Whatever divine heat of thine, O Gharma..."
Having thrown the third [brand into the fire] and sat down,

sanskrit_iast: kṣatrasya tvā \\ iti niṣkramaṇaṃ purastāt patnīm antardhāya //
meaning: क्षत्रस्य त्वा \\ इति निष्क्रमणं पुरस्तात् पत्नीम् अन्तर्धाय //
text_mt: The departure takes place from the front with "Thee, of the Kshatriya...", after concealing the wife [from view].
He gives the order for the sāman chant, as at the final bath.
They go to the place of disposal.
Having ordered three times, [the Hotṛ recites] "He has roared..."
He deposits the Pravṛñjanīya pot touching the navel [of the altar], saying: "Four-cornered..."
And the two Rauhiṇa offering ladles, pulled apart, on the outer side.
having placed the grass broom and the cord for tying upon the supporting pan, to the west,
and to the west, the two milking pails on either side of the handle,
the post and peg to the west,
to the south, in the area of the Mārjālīya outside the sacrificial altar, the mound for remnants.

sanskrit_iast: āsecanavanti payasaḥ pūrayati gharmaitat te \\ iti //
meaning: आसेचनवन्ति पयसः पूरयति घर्मैतत् ते \\ इति //
text_mt: He fills [the vessels] having pouring-spouts with milk, with the mantra: 'O Gharma, this is yours...!'
He hands over the remainder, mixed with the fast-milk, to the consecrated [sacrificer].
He summons: 'Sing the Vārṣāhara and Iṣṭāhotrīya sāmans!'

sanskrit_iast: cātvāle mārjayante sapatnīkāḥ sumitriyā nas \\ iti //
meaning: चात्वाले मार्जयन्ते सपत्नीकाः सुमित्रिया नस् \\ इति //
text_mt: [The priests] along with the [sacrificer's] wife sprinkle themselves at the Cātvāla pit, with the mantra: 'May friendly to us...!'
With the mantra: 'Upwards we [have ascended to the darkness]...', he steps forward towards the north-eastern direction.

sanskrit_iast: anapekṣam etya \\ edho 'si \\ iti samidham ādāyāhavanīye 'bhyādadhāti samid asi \\ iti //
meaning: अनपेक्षम् एत्य \\ एधो ऽसि \\ इति समिधम् आदायाहवनीये ऽभ्यादधाति समिद् असि \\ इति //
text_mt: Having returned without looking back, taking a kindling-stick with the mantra: 'You are fuel...', he places it on the Āhavanīya fire with the mantra: 'You are a kindling-stick...'
And the [sacrificer's] wife [places a kindling-stick] on the Gārhapatya fire silently.
He gives the two gold plates of a hundred mānas used in the Pravargya rite to the Brahman priest;
the cow yielding the milk for the Gharma offering to the Adhvaryu priest;
the cow yielding the fast-milk of the sacrificer to the Hotṛ priest;
If the Gharma pot breaks, [the expiation is] as prescribed.

sanskrit_iast: svāhā prāṇebhyaḥ sādhipatikebhyas \\ iti pūrṇāhutim ādyām uttamāṃ ca manasaḥ kāmam ākūtim iti //
meaning: स्वाहा प्राणेभ्यः साधिपतिकेभ्यस् \\ इति पूर्णाहुतिम् आद्याम् उत्तमां च मनसः कामम् आकूतिम् इति //
text_mt: With the mantra: 'Svāhā to the vital breaths along with their ruler...', [he offers] the first full-spoon oblation, and the last with: 'The intention and purpose of the mind...'
And [he offers] with the mantra: 'Prajāpati, while being gathered together...', at the proper time;

meaning: सविता प्रथमे ऽहन्न् इति च प्रत्यहम् //
text_mt: and on every day, with the mantra: 'Savitṛ on the first day...'
One should perform the Pravargya rite for one who deserves to be seen;
The drawing of the curds-Gharma offering is performed with the mantra: 'As great as Heaven and Earth...!'
The consumption [is performed] with the mantra: 'In me [be placed] that [splendour]...!'
In the Mahāvrata rite, [it is performed] with the mantra: 'The gatherer of splendour...'
The chanting of peace-mantras takes place at the beginning and the end, because of what is seen in the sacred study.
